parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the data plane cluster.

parameters.name: HPAEnabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable Horizontal Pod Autoscaling (HPA).

parameters.name: HPAMaxReplicas
parameters.description: The maximum number of replicas for HPA.

parameters.name: HPAMinReplicas
parameters.description: The minimum number of replicas for HPA.

parameters.name: HPATargetCPU
parameters.description: The target CPU utilization for HPA.

parameters.name: HPATargetMemory
parameters.description: The target memory usage for HPA.

parameters.name: LimitCPU
parameters.description: The CPU limit for the waypoint pod.

parameters.name: LimitMemory
parameters.description: The memory limit for the waypoint pod.

parameters.name: PreferECI
parameters.description: Specifies whether to preferentially schedule the waypoint to Elastic Container Instance (ECI) nodes.

parameters.name: Replicas
parameters.description: The number of replicas for the waypoint pod.

parameters.name: RequestCPU
parameters.description: The CPU resources requested for the waypoint pod.

parameters.name: RequestMemory
parameters.description: The memory resources requested for the waypoint pod.

parameters.name: ServiceAccount
parameters.description: The service account for the waypoint. If this parameter is empty, the waypoint applies to the entire namespace.

parameters.name: ServiceMeshId
parameters.description: The ID of the Service Mesh (ASM) instance.
